stories.headline: It was comfortable wins for the sides at the top in the two fixtures in…
stories.body: It was comfortable wins for the sides at the top in the two fixtures in the Division One South. Firstly, Weymouth responded to their first league defeat of the season last time out with a 3-0 home win over Willand Rovers , thanks to goals from Euan Pollock, Mitch Beardmore and Tor Swann.
stories.source_title: Dyno-Rod Round-Up | Chippenham Town move off the bottom while Real Bedford, Weymouth and Dorchester Town get back to winning ways
stories.author: Jack Phillips

stories.headline: The Terras reclaim top spot on goal difference over Swindon Supermarine, with a +26 goal…
stories.body: The Terras reclaim top spot on goal difference over Swindon Supermarine, with a +26 goal difference compared to Marine’s +18, also having two games in hand. Dorchester Town finally picked up a first win after their 10 match winning run was ended four games ago, as they beat Bishops Cleeve 0-4.
stories.source_title: Dyno-Rod Round-Up | Chippenham Town move off the bottom while Real Bedford, Weymouth and Dorchester Town get back to winning ways
stories.author: Jack Phillips

stories.body: Two goals in either half, Tom Purrington and Ethan Taylor in the first, and William Spetch and Oliver Haste in the second half, leaves the Magpies in third, three points off top spot having played a game extra.

stories.headline: Weymouth’s Toby Holmes is the league’s top scorer, scoring 11 goals in his 13 appearances…
stories.body: Weymouth’s Toby Holmes is the league’s top scorer, scoring 11 goals in his 13 appearances in the league so far this season, 32% of Weymouth’s league goals. Weymouth are the league’s joint-top scorers (34), level with Swindon Supermarine.

stories.headline: Willand Rovers denied fifth place Hungerford Town a third successive win on the weekend, winning…
stories.body: Willand Rovers denied fifth place Hungerford Town a third successive win on the weekend, winning 1-0 at home, Charlie Bateson getting the goal. Rovers sit 13th after two wins in eight (W2, D2, L4).
